name: silvershop/stock-alerts
description: Back-in-stock and price-drop notifications for SilverShop: customers subscribe to an out-of-stock product or variation (or watch its price) and get one tokenised, double-opt-in email the moment it is available again or the price falls.

suggest.silvershop/stock: Required for back-in-stock alerts — the restock trigger watches its ProductWarehouseStock. The feature stays dormant (no notify UI, no trigger) until it is installed.
suggest.silvershop/store-profile: Shared shop identity used as the sender name/address for the alert emails.
suggest.silverstripe/spamprotection: Pluggable spam protection (reCAPTCHA/hCaptcha/...) auto-enabled on the subscribe form (a honeypot is the always-on fallback).
suggest.silvershop/newsletter: Lets an optional marketing opt-in on the subscribe form write through the canonical NewsletterConsent gate.
suggest.silvershop/storefront: Ships the PDP buy-box / sticky-bar notify UI the module lights up.
